features: Weighing just 1.5 kg, this laptop offers excellent portability, making it an ideal companion whether at home or on the go. Its sleek design ensures it easily fits into your bag, allowing for hassle-free transportation. Engineered for mobility, you can conveniently take your device wherever your work or leisure activities require. Enhance productivity while maintaining comfort with this efficient laptop.

Equipped with an Intel Core i5 processor from the 13th generation, this laptop ensures smooth and efficient multitasking. With its advanced computing capabilities, it is suitable for processing various tasks without any lag. The 16 GB of DDR4 RAM further supports seamless operation, enabling you to run multiple applications simultaneously. Whether you are working on complex tasks or simply browsing the web, this laptop delivers consistent and reliable performance.

Featuring a 39.62 cm antiglare display with a resolution of 1920 x 1080 pixels, this laptop offers a crisp and clear viewing experience. The FHD IPS screen enhances visual clarity, making it suitable for both work and entertainment. Enjoy movies, video calls, and more with vibrant details and accurate colours. Offering robust connectivity features, this laptop is equipped with Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth v5.2 for faster and more stable connections. The wireless options ensure seamless internet browsing, data transfer, and peripheral pairing. Stay connected with ease and enjoy the convenience of modern connectivity technologies integrated into your laptop.

55 Wh lithium-ion polymer battery with 3-cell configuration and 65W fast charging support. With a battery life of up to 6 hours, this laptop ensures you have ample power for your daily tasks. Its long-lasting battery allows for uninterrupted use during work sessions or entertainment activities. Stay productive and entertained throughout the day without frequently needing a charger. The battery efficiency is designed to meet the demands of a busy lifestyle, offering reliability.

description: The Acer Aspire 3 (2026) is a versatile thin-and-light laptop designed for productivity, multitasking, and everyday computing needs. It is powered by the 13th Gen Intel Core i5-1334U processor, featuring a hybrid architecture with performance and efficiency cores and clock speeds that can boost up to 4.6 GHz. This ensures smooth performance for tasks such as office work, web browsing, content consumption, online meetings, and moderate multitasking. Equipped with 16 GB of DDR4 RAM and a 512 GB PCIe NVMe SSD, the laptop delivers responsive performance, fast application loading times, and sufficient storage space for documents, multimedia files, and software applications. The integrated Intel UHD Graphics provides capable visual performance for everyday tasks, media streaming, and light creative workloads. The laptop features a 15.6-inch Full HD (1920 × 1080) IPS display with an anti-glare coating, offering sharp visuals, accurate colors, and wide viewing angles for a comfortable viewing experience during work or entertainment.
